lines.trans: Max, I heard you have a problem with housing.
Yes, I have nowhere to live in Moscow at all.
Do you want to live at my place for a couple of weeks?

words.gloss: to stay, live for a while

lines.trans: Are you speaking completely seriously, Kostya?
Of course, without any problems, my friend!
Here is the exact address of my new apartment.
I will arrive home around ten in the evening.
Excellent, I will come right on time there.
Maybe I should buy something tasty for tea?
Better buy a pretty bouquet of flowers.
Why do you and I need flowers?
An elderly landlady lives in this apartment.
Understood, I will buy the freshest flowers!
Then agreed, I am waiting for you tonight!

examples.trans: He brought a bouquet of flowers.
I grew up in a communal flat.
The bread rings are very tasty.

вовремя.gloss: on time, at the right moment

meanings.en: on time, at the right moment

всякий.gloss: every kind of, all sorts of, any

meanings.en: all sorts of, every kind of
meanings.note: всякое бывает = all sorts of things happen
на всякий случай = just in case

examples.trans: Alright, all sorts of things happen.
Take an umbrella just in case.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: followed by the genitive plural: 'десять минут'

meanings.en: to agree, to come to an arrangement

examples.trans: There's a new building on Simashko Street.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.
We are looking for inexpensive housing.
I live in a communal flat.
There's someone here to see you.
They have a very beautiful house.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: неделю = for a week; через неделю = in a week
short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job

examples.trans: To wait for about an hour.
I know this town really well!

meanings.en: match (in a relationship: я не пара вам = I'm no match for you)

examples.text: Я понимаю, я не пара вам.
examples.trans: I understand I'm no match for you.
They are a very handsome couple.

пожить.gloss: to live for a while, to stay

meanings.en: to live for a period, stay

examples.text: Хочешь пожить у меня пару недель?
examples.trans: Want to stay at mine for a couple of weeks?

meanings.note: понял? = got it?; понял = got it

examples.trans: Which car did you come in?
Security will be here any moment.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.
They put bad meat in there for you.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

хозяйка.gloss: landlady, hostess, mistress of the house

meanings.en: landlady, female owner, mistress of the house

examples.trans: Right, hand over the money, landlady.

examples.text: Хозяйка квартиры живёт на первом этаже.
examples.trans: The landlady of the flat lives on the ground floor.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.note: plural цветы is used for cut flowers / a bouquet
partitive genitive чаю is common: чашка чаю

examples.text: А я вот вам чаю с сушками принёс.
examples.trans: I've brought you some tea and bread rings.

meanings.note: any thing at all, not a particular one

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
